profile.headline: Experienced teacher/tutor and writer/editor | Seeking a middle/high school science teaching position at a Christian school | MS in chemistry
profile.summary:
I am a talented document specialist and writer/editor who (a) has worked well in several other roles (e.g., as a web developer, web content manager, teacher/tutor) and (b) has a master's degree in chemistry with highest honors.  You may wonder, "Why on earth would someone with that qualification not be working in a laboratory?"  The reason is simple: I discovered that lab work was not my passion!
 
Two things that I enjoy doing and am adept at are
 
1.     Bringing order and efficiency to chaos.  For example, working part-time at Calvert Investments, I brought order and efficiency to Calvert's process of filing marketing pieces with certain broker-dealer (BD) firms.  Before I arrived on the scene, tracking of the process was done via an Excel spreadsheet.  I developed a database-driven system for tracking and reporting on the statuses of those pieces at those BD firms, a repository for the process, and effective partnerships with compliance liaisons at those BD firms.  Consequently, more than 90% of pieces filed with those firms were approved.  I will add this: I enjoy assembling, categorizing, and organizing documents not just professionally but also personally.  Believe it or not, I have a database-driven filing system at home!
 
2.     Explaining difficult concepts simply, clearly, vividly, and accurately.  For example, I prepared a lucid manual that was used to train Calvert's distribution team on the firm's new research system.  Calvert wholesalers hailed the manual as "terrific" and "excellent."
 
I am experienced working with online content management systems (e.g., WordPress) and am skilled in HTML, CSS, and PHP.  Thus, I can edit and format online documents better than someone with no coding skills.
 
I say a bit about my soft skills: I pay attention to details and strive for excellence.  I strive that documents under my purview are of the highest quality.  I am a good listener.  I work well with others to achieve common goals, and I genuinely care how my actions might affect other people.  I am a lifelong learner and enjoy learning to solve problems.  Staying up to date in my line of work is a delight, not a chore.  I am honest and dependable.
 
My ideal role would be managing documents and writing/editing needed documents in a STEM field or in the financial services or healthcare sectors.

positions.title: Writer/Editor and Web Developer (Part-time)
positions.description:
Develops and manages a network of websites characterized by well-written, relevant content and well-designed Revshare ads that blend with the content.  Sites include

Bishop's Bulletin.  Interviewed contributors to get their stories.  Edited write-ups.  Took and/or edited pictures for the site.  Currently, the site ranks on the first page of Google for a popular, relevant keyword.

Chefs Answer.  Works with chefs and a chemist to prepare engaging, scientific articles explaining to readers why they should eat certain foods.

Christian Business Directory.  The directory showcases Christian businesses, entrepreneurs, and ministries in the publisher’s circle that provide excellent services.

U.S. Immigrant Tips.  This site provides tips facilitating immigrant integration into American society.

Community Highlights.  It highlights recurring wholesome events and invaluable services in the DMV.

Uses HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and MySQL to develop the sites.  Uses responsive design so that sites look good on all screen sizes.  Develops well-written content either independently or with others.  Optimizes content for search engines.  Procures graphics for sites or designs them.  Designs and posts webpages.  Develops landing pages for pay-per-click ads and organic ads.  Sets up and manages Google Ad campaigns.  Monitors site statistics, including user demographics, traffic, and search engine rankings.  Works with web-hosting teams to resolve issues with sites.  See my portfolio page for more sites.

Developed and maintained the website of African and Caribbean Immigration and Social Services via WordPress during 2016 to 2019.  Ensured that the site content was clear, concise, current, and optimized for search engines and that the site layout and design were easy to navigate, intuitive, and visually appealing.

positions.title: Marketing Associate – Marketing Operations and Document Management (Part-time)
positions.description:
Managed document-tracking systems and document repositories supporting marketing, compliance, and sales teams:

• Designed and implemented a database-driven system (a) to track and report on the statuses of MPs submitted to broker-dealer (BD) firms for review and approval and (b) to track and report on policies (e.g., disclosure requirements) of those BD firms regarding the filings. More than 500 submissions of more than 100 MPs (to 7 to 10 BD firms) occurred per year, and more than 90% of submitted pieces were approved.  Managed the firm filing repository.

• Managed a repository of sales-related materials on the Vablet iPad app used by Calvert wholesalers (WHs). Uploaded, categorized, and organized documents so that WHs could find them quickly. Updated WHs about changes to the repository.

• Managed the expiration of nonquarterly MPs in Marketrac, the firm's multipurpose database. Untimely expiration meant that those pieces disappeared from the firm's website and thus were unavailable online for clients and sales partners.

Performed administrative tasks, including coordinating the quarterly update of MPs having fund data (e.g., fund factsheets) in collaboration with marketing, legal, product development, and sales teams. Developed the project timeline and update keys and ensured that revisions were made.

Fulfilled technical writing and training tasks:

• Prepared an easy-to-follow manual that explained Calvert's new research system, and it was used to train Calvert's distribution team on the new system. WHs hailed the manual as "terrific" and "excellent."

• Developed a lucid handbook that explained to the sales team what they needed to know about firm filing. The director of Calvert's internal sales team hailed the handbook as being "very thorough."

• Developed SOPs for the filing of MPs with BD firms, assignment of literature IDs, and upkeep of sales-related materials on the Vablet app.

• Trained colleagues via written instructions and in-person assistance.
